| n | 10 | integer, n ≥ 1 | ✓ positive integer |
| y vs. n | 7 ≤ 10 | successes cannot exceed trials | ✓ consistent |
| α | 2 | real, α > 0 | ✓ strictly positive |
| β | 2 | real, β > 0 | ✓ strictly positive |

- **n = 10** — a positive integer, appropriate for a trial count. ✓
- **y ≤ n** — 7 ≤ 10, so the observed count is achievable under Binomial(10, θ). ✓
- **α = 2, β = 2** — both strictly positive, so Beta(2, 2) is a proper density on (0, 1) (integrates to 1). ✓

**Conclusion:** All inputs are of the correct type and within valid ranges. No issues found — the model is well-posed and we proceed.
